summary: Iteration 14 — Sanity check for new feature: Murs Accent service page (/murs-accent) + ServiceType.MURS_ACCENT enum + lead intake. Created /app/backend/tests/test_murs_accent.py (4 tests, all passing). Ran Playwright UI tests for: /murs-accent page (testid + title + 4 model cards + Inclus modal with 7 items + 6 finishes with image-load verification for finish-marble.jpg & finish-brick.jpg + 5 process steps + 6 guarantees + CTA → /soumission?service=murs-accent). Verified soumission pre-selection (gold #d4af37 border on service-type-murs-accent) and service switching (murs→manual→murs). Verified HomePage + Footer + ServicesPage all link to /murs-accent. Regression: 34/34 test_build.py still passing.

issues: Form labels and service-tile text use dark gray on a dark navy background (low contrast). The 3 service-tile labels (Peinture & Rénovation / Mur Accent — Cheminée & TV / Installation de mobilier) are nearly invisible against the dark card background. Recommend using a light text colour (e.g. text-white or text-gray-200) for tile labels and form section headings when the page background is dark. This is pre-existing and not caused by the murs-accent addition, but newly noticeable now that 3 tiles share the row.

action_items: (Optional, design) Improve contrast of service-type tile labels on /soumission so they are readable on the dark navy background.
(No functional bugs) — the murs-accent feature is fully wired end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend ServiceType.MURS_ACCENT = 'murs-accent' is added cleanly to the existing enum; lead creation (POST /api/v1/leads) and admin listing (GET /api/v1/admin/leads?service_type=murs-accent) both accept and persist the new value.
Public lead endpoint correctly lives at /api/v1/leads (NOT /api/leads); SoumissionPage POSTs to /api/v1/leads as expected. No legacy /api/leads route exists — confirmed via 404 test.

MursAccentPage.jsx data-testid coverage is complete: murs-accent-page, model-card-mod-{a..d}, model-included-btn-mod-{a..d}, model-included-modal, finish-{slug}, process-step-{N}, guarantee-{slug}, murs-accent-soumission-btn. Good test surface.

Finish tile slugs contain non-ASCII chars (é, û): e.g. finish-rainuré-noir, finish-béton-ciré. CSS attribute selectors with ^= work correctly in browser but caused a Playwright Python selector escaping issue in my first script — verified count=6 via page.evaluate JS. Not a functional problem, but if other agents want to target individual finishes they should use page.evaluate or escape the unicode in the selector.

SoumissionPage URL preset logic (useEffect reading ?service=) is guarded by `prev.service_type ? prev : { ...prev, service_type: presetService }` — correct (does not overwrite user choice on remount/navigation).
Footer + HomePage + ServicesPage all wire to /murs-accent with text 'Murs Accent (Cheminée & TV)' — consistent labelling.
Confirmation email is sent to lead.email via BackgroundTasks; no blocking on the request — good pattern. The new service_type value gets included in the audit log details and notification email.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (page load, modal, finishes, process steps, guarantees, CTA nav, pre-selection, service switching, HomePage/Footer/ServicesPage links — all verified)

seed_data_creation: test_lead_create_with_murs_accent_service_type creates one TEST lead (full_name='TEST Murs Accent <8-char-hex>', email='test_murs_<hex>@example.com', service_type='murs-accent'). Harmless leftover in db.leads; can be filtered/cleaned by prefix 'TEST'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable: /app/backend/tests/test_murs_accent.py covers (a) POST /api/v1/leads accepts service_type='murs-accent', (b) admin GET filter by service_type returns the created lead, (c) invalid enum is rejected with 422, (d) no /api/leads legacy route. The public lead endpoint is /api/v1/leads (the public form). Admin lead list filter param is `service_type=<enum-value>`. Playwright CSS selectors with non-ASCII characters (é, û) in data-testid may behave inconsistently in Playwright Python; use page.evaluate(JS) for robustness on the murs-accent finish tiles.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The murs-accent feature works end-to-end: ServiceType enum extension → public lead POST accepts it → admin list returns it → page renders all sections → modal opens with 7 items → all images load including local /portfolio/murs/finish-marble.jpg and finish-brick.jpg → CTA navigates to /soumission?service=murs-accent → pre-selection lights up the gold border → manual switching toggles cleanly. The only suggestion is a contrast tweak on the dark soumission form labels (pre-existing).
